title: SEC4: DeliverHandler doc comment does not list step 7b
description: kith-peer/src/lib.rs: The DeliverHandler doc comment (lines 153-165) lists the mandatory validation order as steps 1-11. The implementation at line 267 performs attachment validation as '7b', but '7b' does not appear in the documented sequence. A maintainer reading the doc comment to understand the order would not see attachment validation called out. The doc comment should be updated to include step 7b (or renumber to 8 and shift subsequent steps).
